reviews.review: by far one of the worst games i have ever played. this is not a souls like game. they have replaced difficulty with damage numbers and fat health bars given enemies nearly 360 degree tracking and reduced your accuracy with any automatic weapon to near zero. headshots do almost nothing while back shots do extreme damage. the level up scale is far too expensive and the tactics needed to play this game revolve more around luck than any actual strategy. ive put full clips into GRUNTS and not killed them sometimes they do not even light on fire with a full clip. elements basically deal no tick damage at all. The power shots in this game are a joke as well. grenades fired by you basically do nothing while even getting hit once by an enemy almost one shots you even with an upgraded health bar. 5 hours into this game and i am uninstalling it. heavily advise against buying this game.
